lines.en: Three point seven R, and price never even came close to my stop.
lines.zh: 3.7R，價格連停損的邊都沒碰到。

lines.en: So how did I see this coming? Let me take you back.
lines.zh: 我是怎麼看出來的？倒回去看。

lines.en: Okay, look at this. Price is just sitting on the POC.
lines.zh: 好，你們看，價格就一直黏在 POC 這邊。

lines.en: Looks fine, right? But I'm already thinking short.
lines.zh: 看起來沒事對吧？但我已經在想空了。

lines.en: Here's why. Fifteen-minute chart, every high is a bit lower than the one before.
lines.zh: 為什麼？看 15 分 K，每個高點都比前一個再低一點。

lines.en: Futures CVD? Flat, maybe even ticking up a little.
lines.zh: 合約 CVD 呢？大致持平，甚至還有一點往上。

lines.en: But spot CVD keeps dropping. Spot is selling.
lines.zh: 但現貨 CVD 一直往下掉，現貨在賣。

lines.en: So spot's walking out, and futures are the only thing holding this up.
lines.zh: 所以現貨在跑，價格只剩合約在撐。

lines.en: That's a red flag. But it's not a trade yet.
lines.zh: 這是警訊，但還不能進場。

lines.en: Eight thirty. Boom. Someone market-sells about 190 bitcoin.
lines.zh: 20:30，碰！有人一口氣市價砸了大概 190 顆。

lines.en: We drop right out of the value area, and CVD just dives.
lines.zh: 價格直接跌出價值區，CVD 也跟著往下栽。

lines.en: Okay. Now I make the plan, before I touch anything.
lines.zh: 好，現在先把計畫想好，還不要動手。

lines.en: My volume profile on screen, about the last day, has the value area low at 79,855.
lines.zh: 我畫面上大概一天的成交量分布，價值區下緣（VAL）在 79,855。

lines.en: If price comes back up there, I'm shorting it.
lines.zh: 價格如果彈回那裡，我就空。

lines.en: Stop goes above the POC, 80,400.
lines.zh: 停損放在上方成交最密集的價位（POC）上面，80,400。

lines.en: Target? The next POC down, 77,800.
lines.zh: 目標？下面那個 POC，77,800。

lines.en: Now we wait.
lines.zh: 接下來就是等。

lines.en: One candle. Two. Three. Four. Nothing comes back up.
lines.zh: 一根、兩根、三根、四根，都沒彈上來。

lines.en: And CVD stays pinned at the lows. Nobody's buying it back. Sellers are still in control.
lines.zh: 而且 CVD 一直壓在低檔，沒人買回來，賣方還是佔上風。

lines.en: Nine forty-five, there it is. Price tags 79,850, and the selling kicks back in.
lines.zh: 21:45，來了。價格碰到 79,850，賣壓又回來了。

lines.en: Short.
lines.zh: 空。

lines.en: It never even gets close to my stop.
lines.zh: 價格連停損的邊都沒碰到。

lines.en: Eleven oh one, we hit 77,800. That's about three point seven R.
So, the divergence is the warning. The break is the signal. The retest is your entry.
lines.zh: 所以，分歧是警訊，破位是訊號，回測才是你的進場點。
